original.statement: The CA NameConstraints feature gate is promoted to Beta and is now enabled by default.

decision.reason: [ev-619c0cea3aa4] says the CA `NameConstraints` feature gate is promoted to Beta and is now "enabled by default". That supports a feature-gate subject named exactly NameConstraints, with no component, because "CA" names the issuer type rather than a binary. The note presents "enabled by default" as part of the promotion, which implies the gate was previously off by default, so default-changed from false to true is the right reading. The render validators are inconclusive because the chart could not be fetched, so this decision rests on the release note alone.
